metadata.title: DUO icosahedral level 3 (N=1280 cells, ~1400 km)
metadata.description: DUO triangular icosahedral mesh at subdivision level 3 (1280 triangular cells, 642 vertices, 1920 edges). Quasi-uniform global sphere; constant valence 3. Generated by build_duo_grid via the builtin icosahedral loader; no file I/O required.
